title: Lesson 1 Quiz: How Smart Contracts Execute

questions.text: What characteristic of a smart contract guarantees that its rules cannot be altered after it is deployed?
options: The contract is hosted on a private server
The code is immutable and stored across a decentralized network
The developer holds a private key to modify it
Users can vote to change the rules each month
questions.explanation: The narration states that once deployed, no individual or developer can alter the rules mid-way.

questions.text: True or false: In a collateralized lending smart contract, the collateral is returned automatically when the loan plus fee is fully repaid.
questions.explanation: The narration explains that the contract returns collateral when full repayment arrives.
